plan.notes: Official East Carolina University 2026-2027 Computer Science BS requirements (ECU Degree Explorer). The catalog publishes official degree requirements with no official semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. ECU publishes block-level semester-hour totals but NOT per-course credit values; recorded as official block totals. Block totals sum to 127 s.h.; the catalog program total is 120 s.h. because 7 s.h. of natural sciences cognates may double-count toward general education. Recorded at block totals with the double-count disclosed; per-course credits were not invented. Majors must earn C- or better in all common core and CSCI electives.

courses.title: General Education (40 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 40 s.h. general education block; per-course credits not published. Includes: COMM 2020 or 2410; PHIL 2275 Professional Ethics; 7 s.h. of natural sciences cognates may count toward gen ed; additional gen ed courses to 40 s.h.

courses.title: Computer Science common core (51 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 51 s.h. common core block; per-course credits not published. Courses: CSCI 1010, 1011, 2400, 2405, 2410, 2530, 2540, 3000, 3010, 3030, 3584 (or MATH 3256 or MATH 3584), 3650, 3675, 3700, 4230, 4231, 4520, 4602, 4900 (titles per official program page). Majors must earn C- (1.7) or better in all common core and CSCI elective courses.

courses.title: Cognates (18 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 18 s.h. cognates block; per-course credits not published. Math 6 s.h.: MATH 2121 or 2171; MATH 2228 or 2283. Science 12 s.h.: one option of Biology (BIOL 1100, 1101, 1200, 1201 + 4 s.h. science + 4 s.h. natural sciences gen ed), Chemistry (CHEM 1150, 1151, 1160, 1161 + 4 + 4), or Physics (PHYS 1251, 1261, 2350, 2360 + 2 + 2).

courses.title: Major electives (12 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 12 s.h. major electives block; per-course credits not published. CSCI electives above 2999; SENG 3020 Software Verification and Validation.

courses.title: Free electives (6 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 6 s.h. electives to complete requirements; may be satisfied via a minor. Per-course credits not published.
